# package modbus

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/modbus"
```

Package modbus fingerprints Modbus TCP.

Detection sends Read Device Identification (function 43, MEI 14, basic stream) to unit 1. Any answer with the probe's transaction identifier, protocol identifier 0, a consistent MBAP length and either the function code or its standard exception proves Modbus: even "illegal function" means a Modbus stack parsed the request. Stacks that close the connection on an unsupported function (digitalpetri, NModbus) are probed again on a new connection with a read of one holding register, when the scan allows read-only probes.

In identify mode the regular identification category is requested (vendor name, product code, revision, vendor URL, product name, model name, user application name), following the pages a device announces.
